Sanjay Manjrekar links IPL to India's overseas performance issues

Former cricketer Sanjay Manjrekar has suggested that the Indian Premier League (IPL) may be contributing to the Indian cricket team's poor performance in overseas conditions. Manjrekar stated that selectors should prioritize players who perform well in domestic cricket and possess the ability to adapt to different conditions and challenging pitches. He argued that focusing solely on IPL success might not be sufficient for international competitiveness. The commentary implies a need to re-evaluate selection criteria beyond T20 league performances.
